title: Inter vs Stuttgart: Çalhanoğlu strain confirmed, Sučić in per Sky
caption:
Inter without Çalhanoğlu against Stuttgart tonight? Inter.it confirms a strain in his right thigh, with no recovery time given, and Chivu has ruled out Zieliński too. Sky Sport Italia expects Sučić to take his place, with Thuram favored over Lautaro up front. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
